column1: # The shooting range (FRNG): the fields tools/frngcmp.py compares, FRNG frame by FRNG frame, between
# tools/amigaemu.py frng --trace-ram (vars $B00-$BC5, glob $8000-$80FF, FRNG's code blocks) and
# tools/openmsx_rc2.tcl rc2_fr_drive / rc2_fr_arm (D000h, DC00h: the mirror AM / AG; fr_code).
# The list is what FRNG writes in its frames (a write census of the bench run of 2026-10-27 and the
# REA listings of $1EA00-$1FBE7), less:
#   display: the copper list's colours ($1FAA8-$1FB21), the bitplanes, the flash's sprite records
#     ($1FA8C-$1FA97) and saved line areas ($1EB4C-$1EB59), draw_bob's per-call immediates ($1ED96,
#     $1EE42, $1EE76, $1EEC6), the pending draw's graphics pointer ($BAA), the palette pointer
#     ($1F9B0), the panel's message ticker ($8054-$805B, slots $FD92-$FDA1);
#   sound timing: the music divider ($1EB30);
#   draw_bob's per-call results, which only the same call's caller reads: $B0B (hit), $BA2-$BA5
#     (hit column and row), and the type record pointer $BB8 (the slot loop's, read in the same
#     frame);
#   dead state: the random word $B0C ($1EF6A writes it every frame, nothing in FRNG reads it: REA
#     xrefs $80EC, $10296, $1EF70, $1EF82) and the slots' (-$20,A3) high words $B0E / $B12, where a
#     spawn ($1F12C) stores a register's leftover (D1) that nothing reads.
# Format: ADDRESS SIZE NAME [if=ADDRESS] [; comment]
#   ADDRESS in $B00-$BC5 (the MSX's AM mirror at D000h), $8000-$80FF (AG at DC00h) or one of fr_code's
#   pieces (tools/frngcmp.py PIECES: $1EB46-$1EB4B, $1F246-$1F247, $1F46C-$1F46D, $1F502-$1F50B,
#   $1F60E-$1F807, in that order); every block in the mirror's rule: words little-endian, the byte
#   at A at A ^ 1.
#   if=: compared only in rows where the Amiga's byte at that address is not 0 (the field is read
#   only then: a stale value otherwise).
0b00 2 game_frame                 ; FRNG frames since its start ($1EA6E): the drive's frame index
0b02 2 anim                       ; + 3 a frame ($1EA72; nothing in FRNG reads it)
0b04 2 correct                    ; correct targets ($1F5B6, $1F21E, $1F3B0): D1 at the end
0b06 2 dummy                      ; dummy targets ($1F5AA, $1F3BC): D0 at the end
0b08 2 endc                       ; the end count: + 1 a frame from the frame the ammo ran out ($1EAD6, $1EAAC); 99: fade-out
0b10 2 s0.rise                    ; (-$1E,A3): the pop-up's offset ($1F55C, $1F58C); 0 at a spawn
0b16 4 s0.z18                     ; (-$18,A3): cleared at a spawn ($1F142), nothing else
0b1e 4 s0.z10                     ; (-$10,A3): cleared at a spawn ($1F146), nothing else
0b26 2 s0.x if=0b2e               ; (-8,A3): set by the handler's first call; a spawn leaves D0's leftover
0b28 2 s0.hold                    ; (-6,A3): the rising target's hold count ($1F16E, $1F188); 0 at a spawn
0b2e 1 s0.count                   ; (A3): the pop-up's phase count; FF once a rising or moving target started
0b30 1 s0.b2                      ; (2,A3).w: the rising and moving targets' step ($1F18E, $1F358)
0b31 1 s0.b3                      ; (3,A3): the pop-up's started flag ($1F51A)
0b36 1 s0.type                    ; (8,A3): the type, 1-39 from $B00 at a spawn ($1F134); 0 free
0b37 1 s0.t9                      ; (9,A3): 0Ah at a spawn ($1F13C)
0b38 1 s0.tA                      ; (A,A3): 0 at a spawn ($1F138)
0b14 2 s1.rise                    ; (-$1E,A3): the pop-up's offset ($1F55C, $1F58C); 0 at a spawn
0b1a 4 s1.z18                     ; (-$18,A3): cleared at a spawn ($1F142), nothing else
0b22 4 s1.z10                     ; (-$10,A3): cleared at a spawn ($1F146), nothing else
0b2a 2 s1.x if=0b32               ; (-8,A3): set by the handler's first call; a spawn leaves D0's leftover
0b2c 2 s1.hold                    ; (-6,A3): the rising target's hold count ($1F16E, $1F188); 0 at a spawn
0b32 1 s1.count                   ; (A3): the pop-up's phase count; FF once a rising or moving target started
0b34 1 s1.b2                      ; (2,A3).w: the rising and moving targets' step ($1F18E, $1F358)

0b3b 1 s1.t9                      ; (9,A3): 0Ah at a spawn ($1F13C)

0b3e 1 fx.on                      ; the hit effect: 1 while it runs ($1F95C), 0 at its end ($1F89C)

0b4e 1 fx.last                    ; its last frame ($1F958)

0b9e 2 cy                         ; the sight's y (line: 4 a frame, $10-$9E: $1ED26)

0bc0 1 fade_in                    ; FF fading in ($1FBAA), 0 fading out ($1EAB8)
802e 1 joy                        ; read_joystick's byte (up 1, down 2, left 4, right 8, fire 10h)
